messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate (5-15%) and latency spike on `prompt-routing-experimental` canary (v0.9) in us-west-2. Alert rule: prompt-routing.errors > 5% over 2min.
alex: I'm on it. Paging oncall. Can someone confirm canary rollout params? :rotating_light:
kenji: Canary is 10% traffic to `prompt-router-v0.9` via split-routes feature-flag `ff_prompt_routing_exp`. Recent deploy ~8m ago.
samir: Seeing repeated 503s from runtime kernels serving kv-cache lookups. Logs show OOM-ish traces and retry loops.
alex: Ok — plan: 1) flip the FF to 0% (kill switch) 2) monitor error rate + latency 3) if stable, abort canary deploy. Who can flip the flag now?
oncall-sre: I can. Using internal toggler: `toggle-ff --name ff_prompt_routing_exp --env prod --value off --reason "canary errors"`
kenji: Heads-up: flipping will route all new traffic to the stable `prompt-router-v1` endpoint. Existing in-flight may still hit v0.9.
oncall-sre: Executing now.

deploy-bot: action_log: toggle-ff request submitted by oncall-sre. Request id 93a2.
oncall-sre: Response: 200 OK. Flag `ff_prompt_routing_exp` set to `false`.
kenji: Watching metrics: error rate dropping from 13% -> 3% in the last 60s. Latency p95 also falling.
samir: Confirming backend: connections to v0.9 draining. No new pods being routed.
anya: Customer impact? Any high-visibility customers hit? Need communication if so.
support-bot: Quick dump: 24 distinct API keys saw >5% errors. Top 3 affected: AcmeCorp (internal-prod), BetaApps (dev), NovaSaaS (trial). None on Dedicated accounts.
alex: Good catch. @support-bot can you open a high-priority support case template for the three customers and ping PMs?
support-bot: Case created: #INC-2026-AC, #INC-2026-BE, #INC-2026-NO. Templates queued to growth-support.
kenji: Recommend aborting the canary deploy (rollback v0.9) to be safe. We can re-run after fix and extended integration tests.
samir: I agree. Root cause looks like a combination of a kernel memory regression + atypical request size amplification for a small subset of prompts; need a repro and a fix in runtime.
oncall-sre: Initiating rollback of canary deployment. Command: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/prompt-router --to-revision=v0.8-canary -n inference-canaries
```
oncall-sre: Rollback started.
deploy-bot: rollout status: rollout undo initiated (id: rb-77c).
kenji: Monitoring after rollback: errors down to 0.9% and latency p95 back to baseline within 3m. :white_check_mark:
anya: Thanks team. Customer comms: we'll send a short note explaining a transient routing issue during an experimental rollout, actions taken, and next steps. Please include RCA when ready.
emily: I'm taking the 2hr on-call follow-up and postmortem. Summary for handoff: canary v0.9 introduced kernel mem regression causing retries and 503s; FF killed at +8m; rollback to v0.8; affected hosted customers (no Dedicated). Severity: P2. Follow-ups: repro, fix, test suite addition, improve canary health gating, update runbook to clarify kill-switch steps and notify cadence.
alex: Sounds good. Emily, I'll add you to exec notes and hand off pager.
emily: Got it. Starting follow-ups: creating GitHub issue RD-3147 (postmortem) and scheduling a postmortem meeting for tomorrow 1000 PT.
samir: For immediate mitigation, we should add an extra memory guard in kernel before next canary and enable stricter e2e request-size checks in canary gates.
kenji: Also logging improvement request: capture kv-cache size per request and add early abort on >X tokens.
oncall-sre: All action items captured in incident tracker. I'm attaching short timeline:
- t0 (1775009999): canary v0.9 deployed
- t0+7m: alerts fired (errors/latency)
- t0+8m: FF toggled off (kill switch)
- t0+12m: rollback initiated
- t0+15m: metrics recovered to baseline

alex: Marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep this channel for updates and the postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P2 mitigated. Runbook: /runbooks/ff-kill-switch.md. Postmortem assigned: RD-3147.
